result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per 12 months, 30 days’ written notice, business-hours timing, an independent auditor subject to confidentiality, Vendor-paid costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no direct or remote systems access. It also preserves the existing exclusions and payment of the undisputed shortfall. However, requiring off-site conduct wherever practicable and minimising disruption goes beyond the stated playbook requirements, so the revision is not strictly minimal. The drafting is professional, though the systems-access prohibition is duplicative across Sections 22.1 and 22.2.
